data.long_description:
Discover contemporary living in this well-designed studio apartment located in Azizi Riviera 11, part of the vibrant Riviera community in Meydan.

Spanning 331.10 sq. ft, this studio offers a smart and efficient layout, ideal for both end-users and investors. The open-plan living space is complemented by large windows that allow for plenty of natural light, creating a bright and welcoming ambiance throughout the unit.

The apartment features a modern kitchen fitted with quality finishes, along with a sleek bathroom designed for comfort and functionality. The layout maximizes space, making it perfect for individuals seeking a stylish yet practical home.

Property Features:

Studio Apartment
1 Bathroom
Size: 331.10 sq. ft
Open-plan layout
Modern kitchen with high-quality fittings
Built-in wardrobes
Bright and airy interiors

Community Highlights:

Prime location in Meydan, Mohammed Bin Rashid City
Crystal lagoon and waterfront lifestyle
Swimming pools and fully equipped gym
Retail outlets, cafes, and restaurants
Landscaped gardens and walking paths
Easy access to Downtown Dubai and major highways

Azizi Riviera offers a unique blend of French Mediterranean design and modern architecture, creating a lively and upscale community. Whether you're looking for a comfortable home or a high-potential investment, this property is an excellent choice.

Contact us today to arrange a viewing.
